opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Developing new medicines — up 27% as the pipeline widened.

opex.name: Marketing, selling & administrative
opex.note: Sales teams, advertising and running the company — up 31% to support new launches.

opex.name: Acquired IPR&D
opex.note: Research bought in from other companies, expensed on the spot — mainly the SiteOne Therapeutics deal.

opex.name: Asset impairment & restructuring
opex.note: A litigation charge plus costs of closing the Verve Therapeutics acquisition.

footerNote: Reported (GAAP) figures throughout; Lilly's non-GAAP net income was $6,312M (EPS $7.02).
oneTimers: Acquired IPR&D of $656M ($0.71 per share): Lilly expensed research it bought with the SiteOne Therapeutics acquisition. It is a recurring feature of Lilly's deal-making, but the size swings from quarter to quarter — a year ago the charge was $2.83B.
U.S. tax law changes enacted in the quarter added about $350M ($0.39 per share) to the tax bill, as Lilly remeasured its deferred taxes.
otherDetail: Net other expense of $133M — interest costs of $115M, plus $18M of other net expense.

segments.name: Mounjaro
segments.note: The diabetes shot — $3.6B in the U.S. and $3.0B overseas as launches rolled out worldwide.

segments.name: Zepbound
segments.note: The obesity shot — U.S. sales of $3.6B, nearly triple a year ago.

segments.name: All other medicines
segments.note: Everything else Lilly sells, led by Verzenio at $1.5B — includes a $200M Jardiance milestone and $180M from selling Cialis rights in some markets.

takeaways.text: Mounjaro and Zepbound together brought in $10.1B of the $17.6B total — Mounjaro more than doubled and Zepbound nearly tripled as Lilly added manufacturing capacity.
takeaways.title: Two drugs, well over half of sales

takeaways.text: Revenue rose 54% on 62% higher volume, partly offset by prices about 10% lower — Lilly is selling far more medicine at somewhat lower realized prices.
takeaways.title: Growth is volume, not price

takeaways.text: Lilly lifted its full-year 2025 revenue guidance to $63.0–63.5B and reported EPS guidance to $21.80–22.50, with orforglipron — its oral GLP-1 pill — heading for regulatory submissions by year-end.
takeaways.title: Guidance raised again

verdict: Lilly's revenue jumped 54% to $17.6B as Mounjaro sales more than doubled and Zepbound nearly tripled — and profit rose to $5.6B, nearly six times a year ago, when a huge IPR&D charge weighed it down.
